column1: # PartiQL token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# token of PartiQLTokens.g4 that is a class of texts. Keywords and operators
# spell themselves and need no row. Each note cites the lexer rule.
# A sample of one name, string or number stands for its class when the
# grammar judge reads a statement; a name sampled in quotes stands for names
# in those quotes. (spaced) writes a token with a space on each side.

column3: PartiQLTokens.g4:375 a double-quoted name; "" is a quote in it
PartiQLTokens.g4:360 a single-quoted string; '' is a quote in it
PartiQLTokens.g4:366 digits with a point, and an optional exponent
PartiQLTokens.g4:348 and 449: a backtick enters Ion mode, and the token runs to the backtick that leaves it
PartiQLTokens.g4:327 AT_SIGN is a token of its own before a name; written tight, the judge's lexer would read @a as one variable
PartiQLParser.g4:625 the plainest expression is a name: the rule lists CURRENT_USER before varRefExpr, so the shortest expression would be a keyword every other row then carries
PartiQLParser.g4:30 two identifiers; PartiQLParserDefault.kt:524 takes the parameters TYPE and FORMAT only, so other rows write one
PartiQLParser.g4:399 an identifier; PartiQLParserDefault.kt:1191 takes TRAIL, ACYCLIC and SIMPLE only, so other rows write one
